meta.description: Listens for export.requested events from TalentBridge, claims the export job, paginates collected_jobs, builds CSV/XLSX, uploads to the private `exports` bucket at {consultancy_id}/{job_id}.{ext}, then calls back to mark the job ready. Requires env vars: TALENTBRIDGE_BASE_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Failures should be routed via n8n error workflow to POST { action: 'fail', job_id, error }.
